quarterly_data.quarter: Applied Optoelectronics press release: AOI Brings First Live Quantum30 3.0 GHz Concept Demo to (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CATV roadmap (proof-of-concept only): AOI announced a Quantum30 proof-of-concept demo, to be shown at SCTE TechExpo in Atlanta, of live downstream operation at 3.0GHz over a coaxial plant - the title calls it the first live Quantum30 3.0 GHz concept demo (company claim). The demo consists of actual working hardware: a 3.0GHz concept amplifier, SC-QAMs, OFDM channels and a 3.0GHz DOCSIS signal generator, and builds on the engineering foundation of AOI's Quantum18 Quantum Bandwidth product family. It is a concept demo ahead of any 3.0GHz standard (Corey Chapman, Senior Director of Product Management for AOI's Broadband Access Business Unit, says the engineering decisions need to start 'well before any standard is set'), not a product: no availability, customers or figures are stated. AOI also published a whitepaper, 'Beyond 1.8 GHz: Evaluating Paths to 3.0 GHz HFC Networks', on extending HFC capacity beyond DOCSIS 4.0 at 1.8GHz.
quarterly_data.figure: 3.0GHz concept amplifier (proof-of-concept demo); no product availability stated
